prompt:
Create one landscape three-panel FACE EXPRESSION MODEL SHEET of the SAME original adult woman in the supplied generated portrait. This is an identity consistency study, not three redesigns. Preserve mature 27-year-old appearance and charcoal collared shirt with cream inner collar. Both irises must be fully readable: part the side-swept fringe just enough so no thick hair lock crosses either iris. Do not change hair length, eye color, skull structure, jaw width or outfit between panels. Faithfully retain the reference's attractive crisp anime facial rendering, detailed luminous eyes, thin colored contours, large clean hair highlights and controlled cel shadows with subtle warm cheek transitions. No photorealism, 3D, pixel art, childish/chibi face, lip gloss emphasis or elongated nose bridge.

LEFT: relaxed everyday small closed-mouth smile, calm level brows, upright composed direct gaze.
MIDDLE: focused serious attention, eyebrows drawn very slightly inward, mouth closed level without smile, alert eyes but not angry, maintain feminine adult elegance.
RIGHT: playful amused smirk, one eyebrow visibly raised, slightly narrower amused eyes, asymmetrical small closed-mouth smile. No tongue, no exaggerated blush, no sexual expression.
Different expressions must be clearly distinguishable from brows and mouth while the SAME face remains unmistakable. Do not beautify each panel into different characters. Fully clothed head-and-shoulders only, no hands, no added jewelry or props. Output one polished horizontal illustration sheet.
